description: This Java class implements a content file manager for static content such as images, CSS, JS, videos, and PDFs, using Infinispan caching. It provides methods for adding, retrieving, listing, and removing files for merchant stores, and manages content using cache nodes structured by merchant codes and content types.

classes.name: CmsStaticContentFileManagerInfinispanImpl
classes.description: A class that manages static content files (images, CSS, JS, videos, PDFs) for merchant stores using Infinispan cache; supports adding, retrieving, listing, and removing files.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Stores a static content file (image, CSS, JS, etc.) in the cache under a merchant's namespace, based on content type and filename.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Stores multiple static content files for a merchant in the cache, organized by content type.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves a static content file by merchant code, content type, and filename; returns an OutputContentFile object with file data and MIME type.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Retrieves all static content files of a specified type for a merchant, returning a list of OutputContentFile objects.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific static content file from the cache for a merchant based on filename and content type.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all static content files associated with a merchant from the cache.

methods.name: getFileNames
methods.description: Lists all filenames of static content files of a specified type for a merchant stored in the cache.

methods.name: stopFileManager
methods.description: Stops the cache manager, effectively shutting down the storage operations.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton access method for obtaining an instance of the file manager.
